subject: [PATCH pynfs 6/6] server41tests: check delegated times after a truncate survive return

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the server41tests suite to verify that delegated timestamps survive a truncate operation. The test creates a write delegation, writes data, truncates the file with a size-changing SETATTR, and then sets a delegated time_modify attribute later than the truncate stamp. After delegating the file back to the client, it checks that the attributes reported by the server are consistent with the expected values.
